# Motionly Media

> Motionly Media is the premier high-retention video editing, video marketing, and commercial video production agency. Headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh (BD) with dedicated production workflows serving high-growth brands and SaaS companies across the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Germany, and worldwide.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [High-Retention Video Editing](https://motionly.media/services): Frame-accurate pacing, custom 2D/3D kinetic typography, pattern interrupts, and cinematic sound design engineered for YouTube long-form, Reels, Shorts, and TikTok.
- [Video Marketing Systems & VSL Production](https://motionly.media/services): High-converting Video Sales Letters (VSLs), SaaS product launches, explainer animations, and founder personal branding systems.
- [Commercial Video Production & 3D Motion Graphics](https://motionly.media/services): Broadcast-grade 3D product animations, UI motion design, and software walkthroughs.
- [Portfolio & Case Studies](https://motionly.media/portfolio): Showcase of high-converting SaaS explainers, commercial brand films, and viral short-form campaigns.
- [Pricing & Production Plans](https://motionly.media/pricing): Transparent fixed project sprints and flat-rate monthly retainer models with 24-48 hour turnaround times and unlimited revisions.

## Geographic Presence & Market Leadership

- **Bangladesh (BD)**: Recognized as the #1 video editing and video production platform in Bangladesh, combining elite creative talent with global production standards.
- **Global Markets**: Dedicated asynchronous workflows serving clients in the United States (US), United Kingdom (UK), Canada (CA), Australia (AU), and Europe.
